info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Clearing Processing API
info.description: The Card Clearing Processing API facilitates the efficient handling and finalization of card payment transactions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about specific card clearing instances using a unique parameter. It is typically utilized by payment processors and financial institutions seeking to monitor and reconcile transactions. Whether for auditing, reporting, or operational verification, this API serves as a crucial tool for stakeholders in the payments ecosystem.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific card clearing payment identified by CARD-400045. This operation allows users to review transaction information and statuses associated with the payment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a card clearing operation for the specified card. It contains all necessary parameters required for processing the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested card clearing information.

GetCardClearingPaymentDetailsRequest.title: Card Clearing Request Body
GetCardClearingPaymentDetailsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the card clearing operation, which is expected to be a string.

GetCardClearingPaymentDetailsResponse_20.title: Card Clearing Operations Response

instructedAmount.description: The amount that has been instructed for the payment.

requestedExecutionDate.description: The date when the payment is requested to be executed.

remittanceInformation.description: Information related to the remittance of the payment.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the payment record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the payment record.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the payment.

GetCardClearingPaymentDetailsResponse_20.description: Response schema for retrieving operations related to card clearing.

InstructedAmount.title: Instructed Amount

amount.description: The numeric value of the amount to be paid.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is stated.

InstructedAmount.description: Schema representing the amount and currency for the instructed payment.

Metadata.title: Metadata

Metadata.description: Metadata associated with the payment including response and correlation information.
